description: Unit test class for the Audience class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.jwt package. Contains test cases for JSON deserialization, empty audience handling, and exception throwing.

classes.name: AudienceTest
classes.description: Test suite for the Audience class, verifying JSON parsing, edge cases, and exception handling.

methods.name: fromJsonWithASingleString
methods.description: Tests creating an Audience from a JSON value representing a single string principle.

methods.name: fromJsonWithAJsonArray
methods.description: Tests creating an Audience from a JSON array of principles.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Verifies that an empty Audience has no principles.

methods.name: getSinglePrincipleContainsTheSinglePrinciple
methods.description: Checks that getSinglePrinciple returns the correct principle when only one is present.

methods.name: getSinglePrincipleIsNotPresentForEmptyAudience
methods.description: Ensures getSinglePrinciple is empty for an Audience with no principles.

methods.name: getSinglePrincipleIsNotPresentForMultiplePrincipleAudience
methods.description: Ensures getSinglePrinciple is empty when multiple principles are present.

methods.name: getPrinciplesContainsAllPrinciples
methods.description: Verifies getPrinciples returns all principles correctly.

methods.name: fromJsonThrowsJwtAudienceInvalidException
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when invalid JSON (non-string, non-array) is given.
